Can you tell me how to kill the lights in my room?

To turn them off, use the wall switch, a lamp switch, or your smart-home app/voice assistant if they’re connected. If the switch doesn’t work, unplug the lamp or turn off the relevant circuit breaker—only if you can do so safely.
